_description: Standing enrollment queue for off-watchlist companies surfaced by the discovery layer. Historically a sighting just got noted in a run file and dead-ended. This file fixes that: feeders append to `pending`; the next run verifies each pending board and either enrolls it (-> watchlist_companies.json + move to `enrolled`) or rejects it (move to `rejected` with a reason so it's never re-evaluated). This is what converts a one-time sighting into permanent daily monitoring.

_feeders.description: Scripts/sources that append to `pending`. All are DISCOVERY FEEDERS (they find companies); the watchlist poller is the durable job source once a company is enrolled.
_feeders.LinkedIn alert (Step 1d-2): Daily. Company names harvested from LinkedIn job-alert emails forwarded to the confirmation alias (see pipeline/local_config.json). Names only, never roles: LinkedIn job links are login-walled and are not the source ATS, so every lead arrives needs_ats_resolution=true. Hard cap 15 new companies per run to keep the step's cost flat regardless of alert volume. Added 2026-07-28.
_feeders.harvest_hn_hiring.py: Monthly. Parses the HN 'Ask HN: Who is hiring?' thread via the Algolia API and extracts (ats, slug) directly from ATS apply links in comments -> directly enrollable. Highest-yield sub-500 source. Run on/after the 1st.
_feeders.poll_remotive.py: Daily. Remotive remote-jobs JSON API. Remotive does NOT expose the ATS link, so it yields NAME-ONLY leads (needs_ats_resolution=true) that the enrollment step must resolve to an ATS before enrolling. (RemoteOK evaluated 2026-06-30 and dropped for data quality.)
_feeders.poll_80k.py: Daily. 80,000 Hours job board via its public Algolia backend (added 2026-07-13 -- replaces the lossy WebSearch site: dork, which surfaced ~5 orgs vs 84+ live listings). EA / AI-safety / public-good orgs. Hits carry url_external, so leads arrive with (ats, slug) PRE-RESOLVED when the apply link is Greenhouse/Ashby/Lever; otherwise name-only. Filters to US-reachable, target-role-shaped, non-junior titles. Salary floor still applies at enrollment -- some board roles are volunteer/hourly.
_feeders.poll_builtin.py: Daily. BuiltIn's COMPANY directory (added 2026-09-03), walked over three configured slices with a persisted page cursor -- Atlanta 51-500, US fully-remote 51-500, and US fully-remote 501-1000, all filtered to /hiring/open-jobs. Replaces the role-level `site:builtin.com/job` dork: a role is perishable, a company once enrolled is polled daily forever. BuiltIn hosts its own apply flow and never exposes the source ATS, so every lead is NAME-ONLY (needs_ats_resolution=true). Hard cap 15 new companies per run. TWO company-level gates, both must pass: TARGET_FUNCTIONS (hiring in 'Customer Success & Experience' or 'Operations & Support', from BuiltIn's own function breakdown) and INDUSTRY_ALLOW (added 2026-09-04 -- is it a technology company at all, by set membership against BuiltIn's closed industry taxonomy). Without the second, the queue filled with a car wash, an animal shelter, a bubble tea chain, and a real-estate operator; measured 0% false negatives against the 33 companies in those slices already on the watchlist. Highest-precision feeder on record: 10 of the 30 companies it queued across its first two batches enrolled.
_feeders.websearch board dorks: Daily, run by Claude. site:jobs.ashbyhq.com / job-boards.greenhouse.io / jobs.lever.co target-role dorks. Surface unfamiliar companies -> append to pending.

_schema.pending: [{name, ats, slug, source, first_seen, why, [needs_ats_resolution], [manual_review], [manual_review_why]}] — verify board live + has US-reachable fit-space roles, then enroll or reject. If needs_ats_resolution=true, name-only: resolve the ATS first (site:greenhouse.io OR ashby OR lever <company>). manual_review=true (set by Step 1d-2 when a LinkedIn card carried a tier1/tier2/tier2c title in Atlanta or Remote US) means: if this entry is rejected for having no pollable board, surface it once in the digest under 'Manual channel — no pollable board' before it disappears, then set manual_review_surfaced=true.
_schema.enrolled: [{name, ats, slug, enrolled_date, headcount_band, source, first_seen}] — audit log; the live entry lives in watchlist_companies.json. Carries `source` and `first_seen` forward from the `pending` entry (added 2026-09-07): without them nothing downstream can attribute an outcome back to the channel that found the company, because discovery and resolution always happen on different runs. Absent on entries filed before that date, and on companies harvested by `harvest_ats.py --names` that were never queued; weekly_channel_report.py counts those as unattributed rather than guessing. `source_backfilled` (added 2026-09-07) marks provenance RECONSTRUCTED after the fact rather than recorded at the time, and names the method: "git-replay" (the entry's `pending` record was recovered from an earlier revision of this file) or "watchlist enrolled_via" (taken from the watchlist entry, which often names the discovery source outright). 187 of 689 outcome entries were recoverable; the rest never sat in `pending` at a commit boundary, because a feeder appends and harvest_ats.py drains within a single run. Absence of `source` on an old entry is therefore expected, not a defect.
_schema.rejected: [{name, ats, slug, rejected_date, reason, recheck_if_resurfaced, source, first_seen, [unpollable], [weekly_report_surfaced], [weekly_report_surfaced_date]}] — don't re-evaluate unless it resurfaces with new roles. unpollable=true (added 2026-08-14) means the reason is specifically 'no ATS board was ever found' (a genuine automation gap Aneesh could work around by hand), as opposed to a board being found and the company rejected for fit/geo/category reasons. Set this directly when rejecting for no-board (harvest_ats.py does; do the same by hand in Step 1d). weekly_channel_report.py surfaces unpollable=true entries once a week for manual review; weekly_report_surfaced=true (set by that script's --apply pass) stops an entry from repeating in future weekly reports once Aneesh has seen it. _run_instructions: Each daily run, in Step 1b after reading ATS hits: (1) process every `pending` entry — for name-only leads resolve the ATS first; verify the board (direct ATS API check, or pipeline/verify_workday.py for Workday) is live with US-reachable fit-space roles; look up an approximate headcount_band; then either add it to watchlist_companies.json + move to `enrolled`, or move it to `rejected` with a reason. (2) Run the feeders (harvest_hn_hiring.py monthly, poll_remotive.py and poll_80k.py daily) + board dorks; append any UNFAMILIAR company (not in watchlist_companies.json, `enrolled`, or `rejected`) to `pending`. (3) Prefer sub-500. Reject Europe/APAC-only boards — their fit roles aren't US-reachable.
